notes.title: New patch + Spanish localization
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

We have released a new Cradle update introducing the changes as follows:

— Bug causing performance drops when gamepad disconnected has been fixed. Thanks the colleagues from Unigine for that!

— Spanish localization has been added. Thanks Vanesa Gómez Paniza and Agustín Zammarrelli from ZombieWolf Team for the translation and proofreading!

[img]http://cs628418.vk.me/v628418135/36bed/w0LQPKInh1I.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cradle update is coming soon
notes.content:
Hi there! We are ready to release the update for Cradle in couple of days.
The update includes German and Polish localization, as well as following fixes:

— Gamepad support added. Find the controls layout in the Options menu.
— Alternative controls keys on the num pad added.  
— Camera FOV options added to the Settings.
— Inverted mouse option added.
— Mouse sensitivity range increased.
— FPS drops, freezes on loading textures partially fixed.
— Player getting stuck in geometry fixed.
— A number of mistakes in the Ukrainian localization corrected.
— Error when launching the game under Linux fixed.

We are getting the French localization of the game ready for launch.
Stay in touch!

[img]http://cs622520.vk.me/v622520135/518b7/hpc3RMEk73Y.jpg[/img]
